global_style: High-energy adventure with sun-baked North African palette, saturated colors, kinetic camera, practical stunts, comedic panic amid real danger, stylized realism.

project_settings.location_lock: Moroccan market district, North Africa (NOT European city)

style_overrides.color_palette: warm ochres, terracotta, bright produce colors, sun-bleached neutrals
style_overrides.architecture: Moroccan medina stalls, narrow alleys, textiles and wooden kiosks
style_overrides.lighting: harsh midday sun, hard shadows, dusty air bloom

project_settings.era_lock: Daytime chase, contemporary with vintage tech

narrative_context.time_period: Midday; contemporary adventure with retro elements
key_events: High-speed tracking shot through a Moroccan market
Bearded companion aims a bazooka from the sidecar during the chase
Motorcycle smashes through fruit stands; oranges fly into the lens
Bike launches off a ramp of debris
Floodwater surges into narrow streets, sweeping away the market
narrative_context.cultural_context: North African medina-style marketplace: bustling vendors, colorful produce, sun-baked environment and tight alleyways.

characters.name: Young Reporter
characters.description: Young male reporter with a signature quiff, lithe build, agile rider; dust-streaked, focused eyes.
characters.clothing_style: Light shirt, rolled sleeves, trousers, leather boots, goggles; minimal gear.
characters.personality: Brave, quick-thinking, resourceful, relentless under pressure.
characters.backstory: A roving journalist chasing scoops across continents; adept motorcyclist; often entangled in dangerous capers.
characters.current_motivation: Outrun the flood, protect his companion, and survive to report the story.

characters.name: Bearded Companion
characters.description: Rugged, bearded man of sturdy build in the sidecar; frantic, aiming a bazooka; dust-covered.
characters.clothing_style: Utility jacket, trousers, boots; protective goggles; rugged accessories.
characters.personality: Impulsive, loyal, brave; comedic panic under stress.
characters.backstory: Seasoned adventurer and fixer; accompanies the reporter on risky pursuits; more brawn than finesse.
characters.current_motivation: Escape the market alive, control the weapon, stick with the reporter.

locations.name: Moroccan Market
locations.visual_style: Sun-baked, crowded alleys, colorful produce stalls, dust in air, harsh midday light, saturated hues, kinetic camera motion.

locations.name: Distant Dam
locations.visual_style: Monolithic concrete dam in arid hills, blinding sun, plume of explosion, torrent spilling through spillway.

props.name: Vintage Motorcycle with Sidecar
props.visual_description: Retro motorcycle with attached sidecar; scuffed paint, chrome accents; nimble and loud; squeezes through tight alleys at speed.

props.name: Bazooka
props.visual_description: Shoulder-fired rocket launcher; heavy, olive-drab tube with sights; accidental discharge strikes the distant dam.

props.name: Oranges
props.visual_description: Crates of bright oranges explode into frame as stands collapse; vivid splashes and motion toward the lens.

props.name: Fruit Stands
props.visual_description: Wooden market stalls stacked with colorful produce; collapsible under impact; flying fruit and debris.

props.name: Debris Ramp
props.visual_description: Toppled crates, boards, fabric and market detritus forming an impromptu ramp that launches the motorcycle.
